_comment: The slitting mill's build (SlittingMill/README.md, 'Build order'): its five stages after the frame and their materials, in the only order they go in; read by Machines/Core/MachineBuildJson.cs (its schema) and kept by the shared machine base (docs/modeling/machine-base.md). A material a click, as many as it takes at once. The slitter rolls are ten of the pack's slitter cutters (forged, two from a steel ingot) on two rods; the pinions and great wheel a Jonas gear frame and the game's metal parts (a block); the drive a Jonas gearbox (the rectifier and the cone clutch) and two rods (the rectified shaft and the crankshaft); the shear a heavy bracket (the crank, yoke and crosshead) and a plate (the bed knife); the push bar two rods and an oak plank; rods, plates and brackets of iron, meteoric iron or steel. The knife is the wearing part, fitted as the shear's last material and durable: one of the game's cleavers, iron, meteoric iron or steel, it goes in with the durability it has left (uses is the cleaver's own durability), is worn SlittingMillSettings.Metals[metal].KnifeWear a plate, comes back out by Ctrl with what is left, and a spent one is gone. No block: the mill's records are its own in the recipe export, not the ore machines' generic ones.
